diagnostics.message:
[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The worker Auto Scaling group can launch instances before :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy is attached. Worker node permissions should be in place before instances launch; the ASG has no dependency on this policy attachment.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The worker Auto Scaling group can launch instances before the worker-node IAM policy is attached, leaving nodes without required EKS worker permissions during bootstrap.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The worker Auto Scaling group can launch instances before the default worker role has AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy attached. Its launch configuration/profile does not depend on the attachment, so Terraform may create the ASG before nodes have the permissions needed to register with EKS.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The worker Auto Scaling group can launch instances before :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy is attached. The CNI policy should be available before workers launch; the ASG has no dependency on this policy attachment.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
When enabled, the worker Auto Scaling group can launch instances before the CNI policy is attached, so pod networking may not be ready when nodes start.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The worker Auto Scaling group can launch instances before AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy is attached to the default worker role. Add ordering so node networking is not initialized before the required CNI permissions are available.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The worker Auto Scaling group can launch instances before :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly is attached. Worker node permissions should be in place before instances launch; the ASG has no dependency on this policy attachment.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The worker Auto Scaling group can launch instances before the ECR read-only policy is attached, potentially preventing nodes from pulling required container images during bootstrap.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The worker Auto Scaling group can launch instances before AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly is attached to the default worker role. ECR access is needed for nodes to pull images from ECR, so order creation of the group after this policy attachment.
